# SkillSwap

> Peer-to-peer student skill exchange platform with a credit-based learning economy. Students teach what they know to earn credits and spend those credits to learn from peers.

SkillSwap is a campus-focused web app where students list skills they can teach and skills they want to learn. The platform matches teachers with learners, schedules sessions (online via in-app video or in person), and tracks credits, ratings, and a leaderboard.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SkillSwap and how the credit-based exchange works.
- [About](/about): Design Thinking journey behind the project.
- [Login](/login): Sign in to your SkillSwap account.
- [Register](/register): Create a new SkillSwap account.
